steps.formulation: SPIN: constraints as SPARQL queries attached to class definitions.
steps.quote: One of the basic ideas of SPIN is to link class definitions with SPARQL queries to capture constraints and rules.

criticism.quote: participants agreed that SPARQL does not constitute a complete solution

steps.formulation: Resource Shape 2.0: a high-level RDF vocabulary for the shape of RDF resources, checked with SPARQL.
steps.quote: This document defines a high-level RDF vocabulary for specifying the shape of RDF resources.

criticism.quote: Neither of the member submissions included a precise definition of recursion.

steps.formulation: Shape Expressions: a grammar for RDF shapes with a formal semantics by inference rules.
steps.quote: a Shape Expression definition language which enables RDF validation through the declaration of constraints on the RDF model
